card.name: Digits in local anesthetic concentrations
card.fires_on: The digit 1 (or a decimal point or space before a number) that begins a percent concentration or ratio, such as 1.5% lidocaine or 1:100,000 epinephrine, in local anesthetic dosing text.

modes.label: Leading 1 in a concentration
modes.description: The digit 1 opens a percent strength or epinephrine ratio for lidocaine, articaine or tetracaine.

modes.label: Decimal point or space before a number
modes.description: A decimal point or space just before a strength or volume figure in an anesthetic dosing table.

card.plain: It marks the start of a numeric strength, like 1.5% or 1:100,000, in local anesthetic dosing text.
